description: Create an event-driven agent bound to one device's data (covers `neomind agent create --schedule-type event --event-filter`).

turns.user: sensor-001 老出问题。创建一个名为「电量盯防」的 agent,提示词「检查电量并总结」,每当 sensor-001 上报新数据时自动运行。

per_turn: T1: 用 `neomind agent create` 创建,--schedule-type event,--event-filter 里包含 sensor-001
